Ravi K.: Quick check 5: can we backdate a promotion to the start of the month if approval lands late?
Lina: Short answer: sometimes. Need director + HRBP + payroll sign-off.
Ravi K.: Is there a form or just an email chain?
People Ops Bot: Please use the Promotions Intake form: https://redwoodinference.internal/hr/promotions-intake. Select "Backdate request" and attach approvals.
HRBP Jose: Add a manager justification doc and the competing offer if relevant. We triage these as high priority for retention.
CompBot: Band exceptions > 12% require Compensation team review and Finance approval. Equity refresh may also be required.
Lina: For title-only changes (no salary), we can update org chart immediately after HRBP approval 5. No payroll step.
Ravi K.: PTO/benefits implications? If backdated will the employee accrue differently?
HRBP Jose: Retroactive effective_date updates accruals from that date. Payroll will handle retro pay and adjustments; benefits enrollment changes must be processed via Benefits team.
Ravi K.: Any SLA for triage?
People Ops Bot: Intake triage within 2 business days; comp decisions usually within 5, exec escalations longer.
Lina: If it's a counteroffer for a critical IC, mark "RETENTION" in subject and DM me so I can expedite.
Ravi K.: Thanks 5 filing now.
